locator: I.17: first two replies beginning Ad primum concedo and Secundum etiam argumentum
interpretation: Bounded prose reading of the materialized Latin; no Lean declaration or mechanically verified inference is advertised. Retains real specific agreement and the appeal to each individual’s intellective soul/form. It rejects the proposed inference to an additional shared constituent; it does not claim that resemblance is invented by language or that its explanatory adequacy has been independently proved.
